products.title: The product lineup
products.intro: Everything starts as a lab file. The ones that earn their stamp go to production. Here's what's on the board now.

bench.title: Ideas in the lab — not yet released

about.title: Small lab. Shipped products.
about.body: We're a product studio that builds the whole thing — concept, design, engineering, and the unglamorous work of actually launching. We keep the lab small on purpose: fewer meetings, more shipping.

principles.title: Private where it counts
principles.body: When the data is personal — your collection, your messages, your plans — it should live on your hardware, not our servers.

principles.title: No friction by default
principles.body: QR codes over downloads. An email over an account. If someone can't be using it in ten seconds, it's not done.

principles.title: Excellent over average
principles.body: When there's a choice between "it works" and "it's crafted," we choose crafted — and say so honestly when something isn't ready.

contact.title: Have a product that belongs on the board?
contact.body: We partner with collectors, galleries, founders, and teams who want something built well. Tell us what you're imagining.

thanks.title: Message received.
thanks.body: Thanks for reaching out — we read everything that comes in and usually reply within a couple of business days.
